summary: Pre-built per-gene covariate matrices for TCGA-MESO (Malignant mesothelioma, overwhelmingly pleural in TCGA (51 of 87 cases pleura NOS, 11 thorax NOS, 5 abdominal/peritoneal; 52 epithelioid, 21 biphasic). GTEx has no mesothelium or pleura tissue, so MESO had no GTEx mapping: the proposed mapping key MESO takes Lung (the organ the visceral pleura covers, representative column) and Adipose_Visceral_Omentum (the peritoneal surface tissue GTEx samples), both organ-level proxies in which mesothelial cells are a minor fraction -- read the GTEx block as tissue context, not cell of origin. Expression is tumor-only: all 87 TCGA-MESO RNA-seq files are primary tumors, no normals. TCGA ATAC-seq covered (Corces et al. 2018; the tarball's bigWigs are named MESO_..., read from its first member). roadmap null: Roadmap's 127 epigenomes include no mesothelial, pleural or peritoneal sample (adipose E025/E063 and lung E096 are the wrong cell). encode_chromatin: DNase-seq of NCI-H226, the only mesothelioma line in ENCODE (Cellosaurus CVCL_1544: pleural epithelioid mesothelioma, originally described as lung squamous carcinoma; ENCODE health status 'squamous cell carcinoma; mesothelioma'), no histone ChIP exists for it; 2025 pipeline replicate-1 file. NCI-H2052, NCI-H28, NCI-H2452, MSTO-211H, Met-5A and LP-9 return no ENCODE experiments. Rejected: ENCODE's 'mesothelial cell of epicardium' (in vitro differentiated, embryonic) and adult omental fat pad DNase (mostly adipose, not mesothelium); ENCODE has no adult pleura or peritoneum chromatin. repliseq null: no adult or tumor mesothelial replication-timing source exists; hESC-derived 'mesothelial cell' Repli-chip (ENCSR401KWO, ENCSR326SZT; wavelet, hg19, embryonic) is noted as an unmeasured candidate only. With so little tissue-matched chromatin, MESO is the cohort that stands to gain most from the complete GENERIC. summary: TEMPLATE-DIRECTED MASS FABRICATION OF BIOMEDICAL MICRO/NANOROBOTS AT THE LIMIT is a 770-page, high-density English research monograph on scaling template replication without losing dimensional fidelity, surface integrity, functional consistency or scientific traceability. The book treats the template as a stateful manufacturing ancestor rather than a passive tool. Every cavity and replication cycle is registered so that template wear, release-coating decay, demolding force, replica bias, particle residue, spatial defect clustering and functional outcomes can be linked across the full template life. Its central falsifiable claim asks whether lifetime-aware monitoring can predict rising defect probability before damage spreads. Thirty mathematically distinct research plates cover cavity filling, squeeze flow, material relaxation, cure conversion, shrinkage, residual stress, adhesion, demolding, fracture, Archard wear, coating survival, hidden wear states, geometry transfer, Hausdorff error, spatial point processes, defect ancestry, survival hazards, change points, capability, conservative yield, hierarchical variance and qualified-part cost. Across 82 chapters and 410 single-page studies, the monograph develops replication physics, release mechanics, template wear, spatial defect genealogy, adaptive process control, functional qualification, lifecycle economics and independent transfer. Two hundred Research Gates define blind challenges, strong comparators, evidence packages, hard stops and successor forks. Thirty-three Phoenix Answer Embryos present genuinely different witnesses, challenge artifacts, estimators, controllers, economic falsifiers, release keys and handoff kits. The work is explicitly nonclinical and hypothesis-generating. It does not claim a completed manufacturing campaign, human treatment, autonomous in-body efficacy or regulatory approval. Its release rule is conjunctive: wear, demolding force, geometry, defect clustering, unselected yield, task function and traceability must pass together over the complete template life. Author: Feng Cheng-en (33) x Starli Series: STARLI Research Institute XXXIV / Flagship 09 Edition: Research Working Edition v1.0 / October 2026
